body:
P3 hygiene follow-ups surfaced by the dual-lens (Lens A / Lens B) audit of **PR #452** (TM-7a admin listing moderation). The P1/P2 findings were addressed and pushed on `feat/tm-7a-admin-listings`; these P3 items are deferred per the agreed pass scope.

### Items

- **(A-P3-1)** Remove the redundant `OwnerGuard` from `talent-marketplace.module.ts` `providers`. `OwnerGuard` is already provided and exported by the `@Global() SecurityGuardsModule`; re-providing it locally contradicts the documented pattern (the module exists to kill boot-time DI cycles from local guard re-provisioning, hotfix #243) and is drift that can re-introduce cycles.
- **(A-P3-2)** Add per-handler `@Roles('owner')` on `listings()` and `reviewListing()` for defence-in-depth. The class-level tag is correctly enforced today (global `RolesGuard` reads `getAllAndOverride([handler, class])`), but the sibling `AdminCoachAiController` tags each handler so a future sibling handler can't silently inherit-and-drop the role.
- **(A-P3-3)** Add `@@index([created_at, id])` (or `[created_at desc, id desc]`) on `JobListing` to back the unfiltered review queue, OR document that the default queue must always pass a `status` filter. Without a leading `status` equality, the existing `@@index([status, created_at, id])` can't be used as a leftmost-column range scan on the unfiltered call.
- **(A-P3-5)** HMAC-sign the keyset cursor before reusing it on more-sensitive surfaces (TM-7b note). The current cursor is unsigned base64url of `iso|id`; harmless on this owner-only listing queue, but TM-7b's application queue carries PII.
- **(A-P3-7)** Use a 5xx (e.g. `InternalServerErrorException`) for `review_replay_corrupt` instead of `409`. A corrupt stored ledger row is a server-side data-integrity fault, not a client conflict; 409 mislabels it and a client may retry forever against a poisoned row.
- **(B-P3-1)** Thicken the OpenAPI surface: add `@ApiOperation`, `@ApiBearerAuth`, `@ApiHeader` (`Idempotency-Key`), and `@ApiResponse` docs (200/400/401/403/404/409) plus class-based response DTOs / documented schemas so Swagger emits them.
- **(B-P3-2)** Add e2e tests for guard wiring (non-owner/unauthenticated access) and wire HTTP status codes via `@nestjs/testing` `INestApplication` + `supertest`, covering validation/error envelopes, malformed/duplicate idempotency headers, and the actual wire status codes.

### Reference
- PR #452 — TM-7a admin listing moderation
- Branch: `feat/tm-7a-admin-listings`
- P1/P2 fixes applied in commit `9155f430`
title: TM-7a follow-ups: P3 hygiene from dual-lens audit
